body:
reading the PR and the previous implementation I wonder if we are going the right direction.

Basically the need is to reset page to 0 on most refines. So why would the pagination widget be responsible for that? This circles back to how the helper does it to me.

What if the various widgets were made responsible for the page to show and not the pagination connector itself.

Wouldn't it make things obvious and remove the need for "transitionState" or "isSamePage" API (which only exists because of that page: 0 need and how we decided to tackle it). Not very DRY (well it's starting to be a lot of code to handle that use case) but explicit and simple, before we find a good API to express that (if there's the need, still unsure).
